Aisha: quick sync 17: launching a 1k canary for q4-style quant. need a focused promptset: hallucination cases, entity-swap dialogs, and rare intents.
Mike: dedupe style?
Aisha: fuzzy at 0.85, keep paraphrase families up to 4.
Sora: sampling plan: H500 / M300 / L200. H = entropy >0.9. L = short ctx (<70 tokens) but rare intent.
Jules: paste entropy query?
Sora: SQL: SELECT id, entropy_score, token_count FROM prompt_bank WHERE origin='prod' AND entropy_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entropy_score DESC LIMIT 12000;
label-bot: sample created id=canary-spark-3771, 1000 items, dedupe=fuzzy-0.85, strat=H500_M300_L200.
Dana: golden refresh: I'll add 120 golden entries targeting fabrication and entity-swap severity. updating rubric now.
Jules: gating: hallucination metric drop >3% -> rollback. token-efficiency reg >5% flagged.
Sora: quant config: q4_0 with per-layer clamp on layers 8-11; collecting per-token mismatch traces (ndjson).
Mike: ops: enable prefix-cache traces for 20m window. eng-runtime ok with 24h retention.
label-bot: reviewers: @dana @mike (H), @jules @sora (M), @aisha (adjudicator). ETA 36h.
Aisha: finalize checklist: sample pulled, fuzzy dedupe applied, reviewers assigned, golden draft in progress, runtime logging set, rollback thresholds documented. Kickoff at 16:30 UTC.
Mike: starting hosted canary at 16:30 UTC; route-to-dedicated if cost >2x baseline in first 15m.
Sora: preflight smoke on 200 prompts running now; will post diff shortly.
